name: How the 2002-2009 Herald was swept on this block
checked: Three indexes were built or used over the 375 Herald PDFs already staged at ~/Desktop/SGA60 photo hunt/n0207/herald, which cover 2002 to 2009 complete except autumn 2006. First, the predecessor's herald_text.jsonl, the embedded text layer of all 5,623 pages, which is good from 2002 onward and much better than OCR on these scans. Second, a new caption index of every embedded photograph in every staged issue with the text block underneath and beside it, 5,300 captions, which only exists for 2007 onward because the 2002-2006 scans are one flat image per page with no separate photo objects. Third, for 2002-2006, an index of every photographer credit line of the form Name/Herald and the 380 characters after it, 2,993 of them across the embedded text and the ocrmac page index, which is where a Herald caption of that era actually lives.
why: Every officer name and every remaining worklist name was run against all three. That is the systematic sweep, and it is what turned up the Amanda Allen, Jessica VanWinkle and Ashley Bishop frames. A name that is not in those results is not in a Herald caption for 2002-2009. What the method still cannot see: captions whose photographer credit was mangled by the scan, and mugshots labelled only with a bare surname in the 2002-2006 issues. Those need the page image.

kind: lead worked out: Spirit Master of the Month advertisements
name: Spirit Master of the Month advertisements, 2002-2005
checked: The predecessor left these as the best untouched seam and said they had to be found by eye. They can be found mechanically instead. The ocrmac page index at _herald-ocr-1997-2005 reads the advertisement's own border, which repeats SPIRIT MASTERS around all four sides, and its footer SPIRIT MASTER / OF THE MONTH, with bounding boxes. Taking the union of those boxes on each page and rendering the page clipped to it at 400 dpi puts the whole advertisement on screen in one step. Eleven advertisements were found and read this way: 22 Oct 2002 p12, 7 Nov 2002 p9, 6 Feb 2003 p6, 14 Oct 2003 p6, 17 Feb 2004 p6, 9 Mar 2004 p13, 27 Apr 2004 p8, 14 Oct 2004 p4, 18 Nov 2004 p7, 8 Feb 2005 p4, 15 Mar 2005 p14 (PDF page numbers).

Not one of them is an officer on this block and not one is on the worklist. The seam is real, the method works, and for this block it is now spent.
